categories.SURVIVES_INITIAL_SEVERE_EXTERNAL_TEST: All minimum portfolio requirements are met, no critical prediction fails, frozen recovery thresholds are met, and the framework exceeds the strongest baseline with positive uncertainty-closed increment.
categories.THEORY_FALSE: One or more frozen critical causal predictions fail under admissible measurement, or the aggregate severe-test criteria fail because of theory-owned prediction error.
categories.THEORY_REDUNDANT: The framework is operational but does not materially outperform the strongest preregistered alternative or provide unique matched-output discrimination.
categories.THEORY_UNDERDEFINED: Independent observers cannot recover materially compatible boundaries or constitutive relations under the frozen observability conditions.
categories.UNEVALUABLE_CUSTODY_OR_POWER_FAILURE: The challenge cannot support a scientific disposition because custody, intervention validity, portfolio size, or statistical power requirements fail.
